header: A volume ladder, band by band
subheader: The entry price above, the ladder below
lead: Each row is a quantity range and the rate that applies inside it. The reader sees where the price starts before they see where it falls.
note: The note says when the count is taken and what happens to a seat added mid-period.

bands.text: The range is the row header, so a rate always knows its band.
Figures are tabular, so the column reads as one falling line.
A band may carry whatever else changes with volume.

bands.title: 41 and above
bands.text: The last band usually points at a conversation.
